item.title: Art on the Slopes
item.description: The Arts Station and Fernie Alpine Resort have joined forces for the third annual Outdoor Art Exhibit. With an open theme, community members submitted over a dozen works as original and unique as our community. All pieces in this exhibition were created on skis or snowboards, reflecting the vibrant mountain culture of Fernie, British Columbia.
